messages:
elaine: quick heads-up, i'm iterating on the compact stats card for the console. noticed keyboard focus is almost invisible on the gradient header when you tab through the cards. attaching screenshot: https://redwood.dev/snap/compact-stats-01.png

mike: i can repro on chrome + safari. focus ring is currently 1px light grey (#cbd5e0) which loses contrast on the darker gradient.

sofia: also screenreader output is terse: each card reads as 'button' only. need descriptive labels so SR users know what the card opens.

ben: cards are `role=button` for activation. we could switch to an anchor, but that changes semantics. leaning to keep role=button + better aria attributes.

elaine: proposal: keep role=button, add `aria-labelledby` pairing title + hidden value, and use outline-based focus (no box-shadow). example css: ```css
.stat-card:focus{
  outline:2px solid #2563eb; /* brand blue */
  outline-offset:2px;
}
```
This should be visible without increasing layout repaint cost.

mike: good call. outline is cheaper than shadow. small question: should the outline be 2px or 3px for visibility? 2px works on 14px text usually.

sofia: for WCAG, visible focus must be perceivable. 2px solid #2563eb + 2px offset passes most checks. also we must address text contrast: `.stat-label` on the gradient hits ~3.8:1 per the a11y bot. change needed.

ben: can we bump label color to #f1f5f9 or increase weight to 600 for the numeric and 500 for label? that might fix contrast without brightening the entire gradient.

a11y-bot: Automated scan: contrast failure on `.stat-label` with current color on gradient background (ratio 3.8:1). Recommendation: increase contrast to >=4.5:1 for normal text or use bold text >=3:1 for large text. Issue ID: A11Y-1756.

elaine: action items: (1) engineer: implement focus outline + aria-labelledby + hidden value spans (mike). (2) design: suggest two alternate color/weight combos and upload updated mocks (elaine). (3) a11y: rerun scan after changes (sofia). target for release: friday.

mike: i'll open a PR today with the css + aria markup. quick implementation question: aria-labelledby should reference the visible title id and a visually-hidden `value-<metric>` id, right?

sofia: yes — pattern: `<div role="button" aria-labelledby="title-requests value-requests">`. screenreaders will read both in order. avoid stuffing the numeric into aria-label; using labelledby keeps things consistent.

elaine: thanks all. i'll post updated mocks mid-day and drop the PR link here when ready. :thumbsup:
